Paystand is hiring a Junior Full-Stack Engineer to build customer-facing payment experiences for its open banking network. The role owns scoped frontend and backend projects, uses AI-assisted development, and collaborates with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable software.
Payments
FinTech
B2B
Billing
H1B Sponsor Likely
Unicorn with $1B valuation
Responsibilities
Apply AI coding assistants and development agents across implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation to increase development velocity while maintaining engineering standards
Provide AI tools with clear requirements, relevant codebase context, and acceptance criteria. Critically review generated code, verify its behavior, and ensure it aligns with customer needs and existing architecture
Develop AI-enabled features and integrations using established architectural patterns, with technical guidance and review from experienced engineers
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering tasks and implement improvements to testing, documentation, and development workflows
Evaluate emerging AI tools and development practices, assess their value for Paystand’s engineering workflows, and contribute to their adoption within the team
Deliver frontend and backend features for Paystand’s open banking network, taking ownership of scoped work from implementation through release with guidance from experienced engineers
Build reusable components, APIs, and service integrations that follow established architectural patterns and support maintainable applications
Collaborate with product owners, designers, and engineers to translate customer and business needs into reliable, intuitive payment experiences
Write maintainable code, develop automated tests, and troubleshoot defects to meet engineering standards for correctness, security, and performance
Contribute to technical discussions and code reviews, incorporate feedback, and communicate progress, dependencies, and blockers to support timely delivery

Required
Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and development agents such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or comparable tools
Ability to provide clear requirements and relevant codebase context, critically evaluate generated code, and explain how a solution meets customer needs and integrates with existing systems
1–2 years of relevant software development experience, including internships, or demonstrated ability through substantial personal, academic, or open-source projects
Ability to explain your contributions, technical decisions, and how you validated the results
Practical experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and a modern framework such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular, with attention to usability and responsive design
Practical experience with a backend language or framework, such as Node.js, Python, Java, or Go, including building or integrating REST APIs and working with application data
Understanding of modular code design, relational databases, SQL, and Git-based workflows, including branches, pull requests, and code reviews
Familiarity with deploying applications to AWS, Google Cloud, or a comparable platform, including through personal or academic projects
Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, and application logs, with the ability to follow established deployment workflows and troubleshoot issues with guidance
Ability to debug issues systematically, write automated tests, and validate functionality and edge cases
Foundational understanding of secure coding practices, including input validation, access controls, and handling sensitive information
Ability to connect implementation decisions to customer and business needs, explain technical reasoning, ask focused questions, and incorporate feedback from engineering, product, and design
Initiative to navigate unfamiliar codebases, research and test solutions independently, and contribute early, while asking focused questions, escalating blockers, and following through on delivery
Benefits
Compensation ranging from $110,000 to $130,000 OTE, depending on experience.
Generous PTO and sick leave
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans
Free snacks and paid lunches in the office
Stock options
Tools and equipment
